  • 비타민 B6

    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요

Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 15g), 80~180%

  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients

키즈 짜먹는 비타쭈 비타민 아연 젤리Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc

Made by 농업회사법인(주)힐링팜 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 0.9mg of Vitamin B6, 5μg of Vitamin D, 7mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 0.9mg Vitamin B6, 5μg Vitamin D, 7mg Vitamin E, 6mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 농업회사법인(주)힐링팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin B6 labelled (0.9mg / 15g), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 15g), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (7mg / 15g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (6mg / 15g), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 노란 주황색의 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월
Storage - 수분 및 열에 의해 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.- 어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
